subject: Proposed demo windows + ops checklist for HealthAlpha deep-dive
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@healthalpha.com>, ops@healthalpha.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed demo windows + ops checklist for HealthAlpha deep-dive

Hi Susan / HealthAlpha ops team,

Thanks again for the call today — great discussion on latency targets and data isolation needs. To keep momentum, propose we lock a 45-minute technical deep-dive where our engineers can walk through a short architecture mapping and a demo of the dedicated/private deployment options.

Two options (all times PT):
- Option A: Tue, Sep 21 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Option B: Thu, Sep 23 — 2:00–2:45 PM PT

Please confirm which window works, and whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet for the bridge. I can send a calendar invite once we lock the time. I attached a simple .ics (proposed_windows.ics) for easy add.

Quick ops checklist for the call (so we don't stall during the session):
- Who from your side will attend (engineer + security lead strongly recommended)
- Firewall/allowlist: if Zoom is chosen, please confirm whether you can allowlist Zoom IP ranges or if you need us to use Google Meet
- SSO/KMS: is there any MFA/SSO info we should know ahead of time? (SAML provider, test users)
- Sample dataset access: will you provide a small test dataset or do we demo with redwood-sim data?
- NDA / policy doc if required (we can share a short MSA excerpt)

Attachments: proposed_windows.ics (stub), quick agenda link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAgenda

If you want, you can also book directly on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/ben-redwood/30min

Thanks — I’ll hold both slots for 48 hours.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Ben —

Appreciate the follow-up and the clear checklist. Both windows look doable for the core team; leaning to Option B (Thu, Sep 23 at 2pm PT). A couple quick notes:
- We’ll include Mark Huang (platform lead) and our security lead (ciso@healthalpha.com) on the invite — looping them in now.
- Zoom is fine but security wants to confirm IP allowlisting details. Mark will coordinate with our network team.
- We can share a small anonymized sample dataset ahead of time; I’ll drop that in a secure transfer link after Mark confirms which fields are okay.

If you can send the invite for Thu the 23rd and include a short agenda, that’d be great.

—Susan
VP, Engineering Operations
HealthAlpha
